description: Permanently delete a single NCR — its entire record and every file attached to it. The dashboard's multi-select 'Delete Selected' action calls this endpoint once per selected NCR (see research.md Decision 2); there is no separate batch endpoint.
authorization: Only a user whose session roles include 'admin' (lib/role.js's Admin constant) — not the NCR's Originator, CE/CS, QA Staff, or any Approver, regardless of their relationship to this specific NCR

id.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the NCR document to delete

body.message: Only an Admin can delete an NCR

side_effects: Every file referenced by attachments[].file_path on this NCR is unlinked from disk on a best-effort basis — a missing or failing unlink is logged, never thrown, and never blocks document deletion (research.md Decision 3)
The Ncr document is permanently deleted — its disposition, preventive actions, approvers, closure record, and full events[] audit trail are removed along with it

Nothing is written anywhere else: no new event, no History record, no deletion-audit entry of any kind (research.md Decision 4 / spec.md FR-012) — after this call, no trace of the NCR remains in the system
notes: Deletion is unconditional with respect to NCR status — a 'Closed' NCR can be deleted the same as one in any other status (spec.md FR-011)

A 404 on one id in a multi-select batch (e.g., another admin already deleted it) does not imply anything about the other ids in that batch — the dashboard issues one independent request per selected NCR and tallies results itself (spec.md FR-009)
This is a hard, unrecoverable delete — there is no soft-delete/archived flag and no way to undo it through any user-facing feature (spec.md FR-010)
